description.value: Kin's Farm Market is a 100% Canadian-owned specialty produce retailer founded in 1983 from a small stand at Granville Island Public Market by a family of immigrants who built the business from scratch. Now spanning 23 locations across the Lower Mainland, the Davie Street store offers an extensive selection of locally-grown BC fruits and vegetables alongside global produce, with an emphasis on organic options. It sits in Vancouver's West End, making it a convenient resupply point for cyclists traveling along the Davie Street corridor.
